gloss: food to accompany sake; drinking snacks

definitions.gloss: food served with sake; drinking snacks
definitions.explanation: dishes meant to be enjoyed while drinking alcohol
something to talk about during a drinking session (figurative)

examples.japanese: ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最適|さいてき}→最適：13010_saiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: Edamame is perfect as a drinking snack.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: This sashimi is perfect to go with sake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: I made some simple drinking snacks and welcomed my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{失敗談|しっぱいだん}→失敗談：09950_shippaidan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}になった。
examples.english: That failure story became a topic of conversation while drinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}にして⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: We drink while chatting about old times.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: That story is only good for drinking conversation.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{肴|さかな}→肴：13929_sakana⟧ originally meant "food served with sake" before it came to mean "fish." The word ⟦{肴|さかな}→肴：13929_sakana⟧ is written with a different kanji (⟦{肴|さかな}→肴：13929_sakana⟧) than the common word for fish (⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧ - drinking snacks (more casual)
- {酒肴|しゅこう} - drinking food (more formal/literary)
- ⟦あて→あて：07858_ate⟧ - Kansai dialect for drinking snacks

COMMON DRINKING SNACKS IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧ (edamame)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧ (yakitori)
- ⟦{冷奴|ひややっこ}→冷奴：27679_hiyayakko⟧ (cold tofu)
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickles)
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sashimi)
